packageRevisionNote: RC1.1 is a packaging-only correction to the manifest's own evidence reporting. It does not alter standard version 1.0-pilot-rc1, any of the 106 rules, or any payload file. All four payload-file hashes below are identical to those recorded in the RC1 manifest.

registrationSuppressesFutureRecruitment.evidence: WEB-REC-005 is a Mandatory blocker requiring a registered person be removed from all remaining recruitment sends.

internalTestExcludedFromCustomerPathsAnd.evidence: WEB-REC-008 excludes internal/test records from recruitment; WEB-FU-INT-001 excludes them from recruitment, attendance, follow-up, and reporting. Both are Mandatory blockers.

noCommunicationScheduledInPast.evidence: WEB-REC-011 and WEB-WIN-006 are both Mandatory blockers prohibiting any communication scheduled in the past or after the event has started.

eventStatusAndParticipantStatusSeparate.evidence: Governed by the archived implementation authorization, section 3, not by an individual rule ID in this catalog. No rule in this catalog references or requires a single combined status field; none was found to conflict with this separation.

attendancePerRegistrant.evidence: WEB-FU-UNK-001 through 003 operate on a per-person reconciliation basis, consistent with the per-registrant attendance model required by the archived authorization, section 3.

attendedAbsentDistinctVariants.evidence: WEB-FU-VAR-001 is a Mandatory blocker requiring distinct attended and absent message variants.

attendanceUnknownCannotGenerateBothVaria.evidence: WEB-FU-UNK-002 is a Mandatory blocker prohibiting conflicting attended and absent messages to the same person.

sharedFollowUpAssetsPermitted.evidence: WEB-FU-VAR-001's expected behavior explicitly permits a shared destination alongside distinct message variants.

registrationTestingNonOverridable.evidence: WEB-QA-003 and WEB-RDY-REC-002 both have exceptionEligible false.

joinLinkVenueTestingNonOverridable.evidence: WEB-QA-004 and WEB-RDY-RUN-001 both have exceptionEligible false.

governedNamingTaxonomyUtmNonBypassable.evidence: WEB-QA-005, WEB-QA-006, and WEB-RDY-REC-008 are all Mandatory blockers with exceptionEligible false; no documented-dependency bypass remains.

noRuleAuthorizesExternalSend.evidence: No rule in this catalog authorizes or references live external delivery; every communication-oriented rule states required content and timing, not a live-send authorization. The pilot delivery boundary limiting all of this to preview and simulation is set by the archived implementation authorization, section 5, which this catalog does not override.
noRuleAuthorizesExternalSend.interpretiveNote: Several rules (e.g. WEB-REG-001, WEB-FU-ATT-001) use the verb 'sent' to describe the required designed behavior once a communication channel is truly enabled. This describes what the standard requires of the behavior, not an authorization to enable real sending during the pilot; that authorization is withheld by the separate implementation authorization document, not granted by this catalog.

noRuleAuthorizesDeployment.evidence: No rule in this catalog references deployment, and deployment authorization is withheld by the archived implementation authorization, section 12 and its closing line.
